subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS replace the dedicated Agent and Session pages with Home controls and support model selection only when the paired Phone advertises `model-controls`?
rationale: The branch’s capability gating makes the technical compatibility path deliberate, but deciding whether this navigation replacement and paired-version behavior are the permanent product contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept the consolidated Home workflow
options.body: Approve the Home-only context controls and capability-gated fallback as the supported Wear navigation and mixed-version contract.

options.title: Retain dedicated context pages
options.body: Keep the existing Agent and Session pages and narrow the PR to any independently desired model-control improvements.

options.title: Pause for a broader Wear navigation decision
options.body: Defer the change until the owner defines the long-term information architecture for constrained watch displays.

recommendation.title: Accept the consolidated Home workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the Home-only context controls and capability-gated fallback as the supported Wear navigation and mixed-version contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the PR and authored the branch’s subsequent compatibility hardening.
